sentence: This project builds a framework that combines simulation and design optimization into a single process to design silicon photonic chips.
This project builds a software platform that generates feedback for training and evaluating artificial intelligence systems.
This project builds an intelligent coding agent that gives feedback on secure coding.
This project uses gene editing to engineer tomato to produce high value terpenoids in fruit.
This project uses brush polymers to make antibody drug conjugates that deliver more drugs per antibody to breast cancer.
This project works on biosensors for health problems such as tick-borne infections, cancer, and cardiovascular disease.
This project tries to find out whether habitat fragmentation harms biodiversity or whether the harm is due to habitat loss.
This project studies how a receptor at the surface of maize cells detects bacterial flagellin and starts immune responses.
This project tries to find out how hollow ions form and behave in pulsed power plasmas.
This project studies how mixing mitochondrial and nuclear genes from different populations harms hybrid swordtail fish.
This project works on engineering solutions that improve healthcare accessibility in low-resource settings.
This project tries to find out why metachronal rowing works for swimming across organisms of very different sizes.
This project builds a mathematical framework and quantum algorithms to control quantum systems that interact with their environment.
This project builds a model of human vision that learns to see by actively exploring its environment.
This project studies how plants add and remove a chemical modification on RNA and how that affects their response to bacterial pathogens.
This project works on drones with sensors that detect gas leaks and airborne particulates and can work in harsh environments.
This project builds learning methods that let autonomous systems learn from data while respecting safety constraints.
